source.text: וַיֵּצְאוּ֮ כָּל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וַתִּקָּהֵ֨ל הָעֵדָ֜ה כְּאִ֣ישׁ אֶחָ֗ד לְמִדָּן֙ וְעַד־בְּאֵ֣ר שֶׁ֔בַע וְאֶ֖רֶץ הַגִּלְעָ֑ד אֶל־יְהוָ֖ה הַמִּצְפָּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And went out all [the] sons of Israel, and was assembled the congregation as one man, from Dan and to Beersheba and [the] land of the Gilead, to Yahweh [at] the Mizpah.

en.L: And all the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel went out, and the congregation assembled as one man, from Dan to Beersheba, and the land of Gilead, to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} at Mizpah.
en.B: Then all the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} came out, from Dan to Beersheba and from the land of Gilead, and the congregation gathered as one before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} at Mizpah.
en.R: Then all the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} came together, from Dan in the far north to Beersheba in the far south, and from the land of Gilead east of the Jordan. The whole community met as one before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} at Mizpah.

sw.L: Nao wana wote wa Israeli wakatoka, nayo jumuiya ikakusanyika kama mtu mmoja, kutoka Dani hadi Beer-sheba, na nchi ya Gileadi, kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huko Mizpa.
sw.B: Kisha Waisraeli wote walitoka, kuanzia Dani mpaka Beer-sheba na kutoka nchi ya Gileadi, nayo jumuiya ikakusanyika kama mtu mmoja mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huko Mizpa.
sw.R: Kisha Waisraeli wote walikusanyika, kuanzia Dani kule kaskazini kabisa mpaka Beer-sheba kule kusini kabisa, na kutoka nchi ya Gileadi mashariki ya Yordani. Jumuiya yote ilikutana kama mtu mmoja mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huko Mizpa.

es.L: Y salieron todos los hijos de Israel, y se reunió la comunidad como un solo hombre, desde Dan hasta Beerseba, y la tierra de Galaad, ante {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} en Mizpa.
es.B: Entonces todos los israelitas salieron, desde Dan hasta Beerseba y desde la tierra de Galaad, y la comunidad se reunió como un solo hombre delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} en Mizpa.
es.R: Entonces todos los israelitas se reunieron, desde Dan, en el extremo norte, hasta Beerseba, en el extremo sur, y desde la tierra de Galaad, al este del Jordán. Toda la comunidad se reunió como un solo hombre delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} en Mizpa.

fr.L: Et tous les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël sortirent, et la communauté se rassembla comme un seul homme, depuis Dan jusqu’à Beer-Shéba, et le pays de Galaad, auprès {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} à Mitspa.
fr.B: Alors tous les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} sortirent, depuis Dan jusqu’à Beer-Shéba et depuis le pays de Galaad, et la communauté se rassembla comme un seul homme devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} à Mitspa.
fr.R: Alors tous les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} se sont rassemblés, depuis Dan, tout au nord, jusqu’à Beer-Shéba, tout au sud, et depuis le pays de Galaad, à l’est du Jourdain. Toute la communauté s’est réunie d’un même cœur devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} à Mitspa.

vi.L: Toàn thể con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên kéo ra, và hội chúng nhóm lại như một người, từ Đan cho đến Bê-e-Sê-ba, và xứ Ga-la-át, đến cùng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tại Mích-pa.
vi.B: Bấy giờ toàn thể dân Y-sơ-ra-ên kéo ra, từ Đan cho đến Bê-e-Sê-ba và từ xứ Ga-la-át, và hội chúng nhóm lại như một người trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tại Mích-pa.
vi.R: Bấy giờ toàn thể dân Y-sơ-ra-ên tụ họp lại, từ Đan ở tận phía bắc đến Bê-e-Sê-ba ở tận phía nam, và từ xứ Ga-la-át ở phía đông sông Giô-đanh. Cả cộng đồng nhóm lại như một người trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tại Mích-pa.

ko.L: 그러자 이스라엘 자손이 모두 나왔다. 단에서부터 브엘세바까지, 그리고 길르앗 땅에서 회중이 한 사람처럼 미스바로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 모였다.
ko.B: 그러자 단에서부터 브엘세바까지, 그리고 길르앗 땅에서 이스라엘 자손이 모두 나왔다. 회중이 한마음으로 미스바에서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에 모였다.
ko.R: 그러자 이스라엘 백성이 모두 모였다. 북쪽 끝 단에서부터 남쪽 끝 브엘세바까지, 그리고 요단강 동쪽 길르앗 땅에서도 왔다. 온 공동체가 하나가 되어 미스바에서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에 모였다.

pt.L: E todos os filhos de Israel saíram, e a comunidade se reuniu como um só homem, de Dã até Berseba, e a terra de Gileade, diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, em Mispá.
pt.B: Então todos os israelitas saíram, de Dã até Berseba e da terra de Gileade, e a comunidade se reuniu como um só homem diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, em Mispá.
pt.R: Então todos os israelitas se reuniram, desde Dã, no extremo norte, até Berseba, no extremo sul, e também da terra de Gileade, a leste do Jordão. A comunidade inteira se reuniu como um só homem diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, em Mispá.

decisions.choice: from Dan to Beersheba, and Gilead: the whole of Israel, north, south and east of the Jordan
decisions.reason: Dan was the northernmost town (18:29) and Beersheba the southernmost, so "from Dan to Beersheba" means the whole land west of the Jordan (1 Samuel 3:20). Gilead adds the tribes east of the Jordan. Every part of Israel answered the summons the Levite sent out (19:29-30).

decisions.choice: as one man: all together, with one purpose
decisions.reason: The phrase pictures the whole people acting as if they were a single person. It comes again in verses 8 and 11, and it stresses how united the tribes were against Benjamin.

decisions.choice: to the LORD at Mizpah: a gathering held in the LORD's presence
decisions.reason: Mizpah ("lookout") was a town in Benjamin's land, north of Jerusalem, where Israel later gathered before the LORD again (1 Samuel 7:5-6; 10:17). To assemble "to the LORD" means the meeting was held as before God, not only as a council of the tribes.

decisions.choice: in the far north ... in the far south ... east of the Jordan
decisions.reason: Readable says where the places lay, so the reader sees that the phrase means the whole country (m1).

decisions.choice: "jumuiya" for the congregation; "kusanyiko" for the assembly (verse 2)
decisions.reason: As in the Pentateuch drafts: "jumuiya" is the people as one community, "kusanyiko" the gathering itself; Readable says "jumuiya yote", as the English Readable "the whole community".

decisions.choice: "la comunidad" for the congregation and "la asamblea" for the assembly (verse 2); "como un solo hombre"
decisions.reason: As the Pentateuch terms set: the congregation is "la comunidad" and the assembly "la asamblea". "Como un solo hombre" is the Spanish idiom for acting all together (m2), and it says the same as the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: "la communauté"; "Mitspa"; "Beer-Shéba", "Béthel"
decisions.reason: For Judges 20-21: the congregation is "la communauté", keeping "l'assemblée" for the other Hebrew word (verse 2), as the Pentateuch terms list sets. This Mitspa is the town of Benjamin, written as the Mitspa of Gilead in chapter 11; Beersheba and Bethel keep the French forms of Genesis.

decisions.choice: "hội chúng" (L, B), "cả cộng đồng" (R) for *edah*
decisions.reason: The gathered people of Israel, as the Numbers–Ruth terms note sets for "congregation" and "community".

decisions.choice: de Dã até Berseba; Gileade; Mispá
decisions.reason: For the whole book: "de Dã até Berseba" is the phrase for the whole land (m1), with "Berseba" as Genesis 21:14 and "Gileade" and "Mispá" as Genesis 31 have them in Portuguese. "Até" keeps the sense of the whole stretch, from one end to the other. As 1:1 sets it, "os filhos de Israel" and "os israelitas" need no gender setting.

decisions.choice: como um só homem (every level); a comunidade
decisions.reason: The phrase comes back in verses 8 and 11 (m2), and Portuguese keeps it word for word at every level so that the reader hears the repetition; "a comunidade" is the word for the ʿedah, as docs/pentateuch-portuguese-terms.md sets it.

source.text: וַיִּֽתְיַצְּב֞וּ פִּנּ֣וֹת כָּל־הָעָ֗ם כֹּ֚ל שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בִּקְהַ֖ל עַ֣ם הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים אַרְבַּ֨ע מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֛לֶף אִ֥ישׁ רַגְלִ֖י שֹׁ֥לֵֽף חָֽרֶב׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And presented themselves [the] corners of all the people, all [the] tribes of Israel, in [the] assembly of [the] people of the God: four hundred thousand man on foot drawing [the] sword.

en.L: And the corners of all the people, all the tribes of Israel, presented themselves in the assembly of the people of God: 400,000 men on foot drawing [the] sword.
en.B: The leaders of the whole people, of all the tribes of Israel, took their places in the assembly of the people of God: 400,000 foot soldiers armed with swords.
en.R: The leaders of all the tribes of Israel took their places in the meeting of God's people. There were 400,000 soldiers on foot, all armed with swords.

sw.L: Na pembe za watu wote, makabila yote ya Israeli, wakajihudhurisha katika kusanyiko la watu wa Mungu: watu 400,000 waendao kwa miguu wenye kufuta upanga.
sw.B: Viongozi wa watu wote, wa makabila yote ya Israeli, walichukua nafasi zao katika kusanyiko la watu wa Mungu: askari 400,000 wa miguu wenye panga.
sw.R: Viongozi wa makabila yote ya Israeli walichukua nafasi zao katika mkutano wa watu wa Mungu. Kulikuwa na askari 400,000 wa miguu, wote wakiwa na panga.

es.L: Y los ángulos de todo el pueblo, todas las tribus de Israel, se presentaron en la asamblea del pueblo de Dios: 400 000 hombres de a pie que sacaban espada.
es.B: Los jefes de todo el pueblo, de todas las tribus de Israel, ocuparon sus puestos en la asamblea del pueblo de Dios: 400 000 soldados de a pie armados de espada.
es.R: Los jefes de todas las tribus de Israel ocuparon sus puestos en la reunión del pueblo de Dios. Había 400 000 soldados de a pie, todos armados con espadas.

fr.L: Et les angles de tout le peuple, de toutes les tribus d’Israël, se présentèrent dans l’assemblée du peuple de Dieu : 400 000 hommes à pied tirant l’épée.
fr.B: Les chefs de tout le peuple, de toutes les tribus d’Israël, prirent place dans l’assemblée du peuple de Dieu : 400 000 fantassins armés de l’épée.
fr.R: Les chefs de toutes les tribus d’Israël ont pris place dans la réunion du peuple de Dieu. Il y avait 400 000 soldats à pied, tous armés d’une épée.

vi.L: Các thủ lĩnh của toàn dân, của tất cả các chi tộc Y-sơ-ra-ên, có mặt trong hội của dân Đức Chúa Trời: 400.000 người lính bộ cầm gươm.
vi.B: Các thủ lĩnh của toàn dân, của mọi chi tộc Y-sơ-ra-ên, đều có mặt trong hội của dân Đức Chúa Trời: 400.000 bộ binh cầm gươm.
vi.R: Các thủ lĩnh của mọi chi tộc Y-sơ-ra-ên đều có mặt trong buổi họp của dân Đức Chúa Trời. Có 400.000 lính bộ, tất cả đều cầm gươm.

ko.L: 온 백성의 우두머리들, 곧 이스라엘 모든 지파의 우두머리들이 하나님의 백성의 총회에 나와 섰다. 칼을 빼는 보병이 사십만 명이었다.
ko.B: 온 백성의 지도자들, 곧 이스라엘 모든 지파의 지도자들이 하나님의 백성의 총회에 나와 자리를 잡았다. 칼을 찬 보병이 사십만 명이었다.
ko.R: 이스라엘 모든 지파의 지도자들이 하나님의 백성의 모임에 나와 자리를 잡았다. 걸어서 싸우는 군인이 사십만 명이었고, 그들은 모두 칼을 차고 있었다.

pt.L: E os cantos de todo o povo, todas as tribos de Israel, se apresentaram na assembleia do povo de Deus: quatrocentos mil homens a pé que puxavam [a] espada.
pt.B: Os chefes de todo o povo, de todas as tribos de Israel, tomaram os seus lugares na assembleia do povo de Deus: quatrocentos mil soldados de infantaria, armados de espada.
pt.R: Os chefes de todas as tribos de Israel tomaram os seus lugares na reunião do povo de Deus. Havia quatrocentos mil soldados a pé, todos armados de espada.

decisions.choice: the corners: the leaders
decisions.reason: The word means "corners", as the cornerstones that hold up a building. Used of people it means the chief men who hold up the people (1 Samuel 14:38; Isaiah 19:13).

decisions.choice: 400,000: a very large army; the word for "thousand" may also name a unit
decisions.reason: As noted at Numbers 1, the word for "thousand" can also be used of a military or clan unit, which would give a much smaller number of men. The same question applies to every large number in this chapter.

decisions.choice: drawing the sword: armed fighting men
decisions.reason: A man "drawing the sword" is one fit and armed to fight. The phrase recurs through the chapter (verses 15, 17, 25, 35, 46) as the way the armies are counted.
Numbers above ninety-nine are written in numerals.

decisions.choice: leaders
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the meaning of "corners" (m1); Literal keeps the picture.

decisions.choice: large numbers in figures ("400,000"), as the English and the Swahili of Numbers write them; numbers under a hundred in words
decisions.reason: Swahili running text writes small numbers in words; for the army counts of these chapters, the figures are clearer and keep the Swahili in step with the English and with the census lists of Numbers.

decisions.choice: "los ángulos" (L); "los jefes" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture of the "corners" that hold the people up, "ángulos" being the corner stones of a building; Balanced and Readable say "los jefes", the leaders it means (m1).

decisions.choice: "les angles" (L); "les chefs" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew calls the leaders "the corners" of the people, the stones that hold a building together (m1). Literal keeps the picture; Balanced and Readable say "les chefs", as the English says "leaders".

decisions.choice: "các thủ lĩnh" at Literal for "the corners"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew picture of the "corners" of the people means its leaders (meaning decision); "các góc" would not be understood in Vietnamese.

decisions.choice: "우두머리들" at Literal for the Hebrew "corners"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew calls the leaders the "corners" of the people, the stones that hold a building together. Korean "모퉁이들" would not be understood as people, so Literal says "우두머리들" (chiefs) and Balanced and Readable "지도자들".

decisions.choice: que puxavam [a] espada (L); armados de espada (B, R)
decisions.reason: For the whole chapter (verses 15, 17, 25, 35, 46): the count of armed men (m3) keeps one wording at each level. Literal keeps the verb "puxar", to draw a sword from its sheath; Balanced and Readable say what it means. Round numbers are written in words and the one long count that is not round (25.100, verse 35) in figures, with the point for thousands (docs/portuguese-style.md section 5).

decisions.choice: os cantos
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture (m1), as the English Literal says "corners"; Balanced and Readable say "os chefes".

source.text: וַֽיִּשְׁמְעוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֔ן כִּֽי־עָל֥וּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הַמִּצְפָּ֑ה וַיֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל דַּבְּר֕וּ אֵיכָ֥ה נִהְיְתָ֖ה הָרָעָ֥ה הַזֹּֽאת׃

records.literal_gloss: And heard [the] sons of Benjamin that had gone up [the] sons of Israel [to] the Mizpah. And said [the] sons of Israel, Speak: how did happen the evil the this?

en.L: And the sons of Benjamin heard that the sons of Israel had gone up to Mizpah. And the sons of Israel said, "Speak: how did this evil happen?"
en.B: The Benjaminites heard that the Israelites had gone up to Mizpah. Then the Israelites said, "Tell us how this evil thing happened."
en.R: The men of Benjamin heard that the rest of the Israelites had gone up to Mizpah. The Israelites said, "Tell us how this terrible crime happened."

sw.L: Nao wana wa Benyamini wakasikia ya kuwa wana wa Israeli wamepanda Mizpa. Nao wana wa Israeli wakasema, "Semeni: uovu huu ulitukiaje?"
sw.B: Wabenyamini walisikia kwamba Waisraeli wamepanda Mizpa. Kisha Waisraeli wakasema, "Tuambieni jinsi uovu huu ulivyotukia."
sw.R: Watu wa Benyamini walisikia kwamba Waisraeli wengine wamepanda Mizpa. Waisraeli walisema, "Tuambieni jinsi uhalifu huu mbaya ulivyotukia."

es.L: Y oyeron los hijos de Benjamín que los hijos de Israel habían subido a Mizpa. Y dijeron los hijos de Israel: «{{plural_you:Digan|Decid}}: ¿cómo sucedió esta maldad?».
es.B: Los benjamitas se enteraron de que los israelitas habían subido a Mizpa. Entonces los israelitas dijeron: «{{plural_you:Cuéntennos|Contadnos}} cómo sucedió esta maldad».
es.R: Los hombres de Benjamín oyeron que los demás israelitas habían subido a Mizpa. Los israelitas dijeron: «{{plural_you:Cuéntennos|Contadnos}} cómo pasó este crimen tan terrible».

fr.L: Et les fils de Benjamin apprirent que les fils d’Israël étaient montés à Mitspa. Et les fils d’Israël dirent : « Parlez : comment ce mal est-il arrivé ? »
fr.B: Les Benjaminites apprirent que les Israélites étaient montés à Mitspa. Les Israélites dirent alors : « Racontez-nous comment ce crime a été commis. »
fr.R: Les hommes de Benjamin ont appris que le reste des Israélites étaient montés à Mitspa. Les Israélites ont dit : « Racontez-nous comment ce crime terrible est arrivé. »

vi.L: Con cháu Bên-gia-min nghe rằng con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên đã đi lên Mích-pa. Con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên nói: "Hãy nói đi: điều ác này đã xảy ra thế nào?"
vi.B: Người Bên-gia-min nghe tin dân Y-sơ-ra-ên đã đi lên Mích-pa. Bấy giờ dân Y-sơ-ra-ên nói: "Hãy kể cho chúng tôi biết điều ác này đã xảy ra thế nào."
vi.R: Những người Bên-gia-min nghe tin các chi tộc khác của Y-sơ-ra-ên đã đi lên Mích-pa. Dân Y-sơ-ra-ên nói: "Hãy kể cho chúng tôi biết tội ác khủng khiếp này đã xảy ra thế nào."

ko.L: 베냐민 자손은 이스라엘 자손이 미스바로 올라갔다는 말을 들었다. 이스라엘 자손이 말했다. "말하여라. 이 악한 일이 어떻게 일어났느냐?"
ko.B: 베냐민 사람들은 이스라엘 자손이 미스바로 올라갔다는 소식을 들었다. 이스라엘 자손이 말했다. "이 악한 일이 어떻게 일어났는지 말해 보아라."
ko.R: 베냐민 사람들은 다른 이스라엘 백성이 미스바로 올라갔다는 소식을 들었다. 이스라엘 백성이 말했다. "이 끔찍한 죄가 어떻게 일어났는지 말해 보아라."

pt.L: E os filhos de Benjamim ouviram que os filhos de Israel tinham subido a Mispá. E os filhos de Israel disseram: "Falem: como aconteceu este mal?"
pt.B: Os benjamitas ouviram que os israelitas tinham subido a Mispá. Então os israelitas disseram: "Contem-nos como aconteceu essa maldade."
pt.R: Os homens de Benjamim ficaram sabendo que os outros israelitas tinham subido a Mispá. Os israelitas disseram: "Contem-nos como aconteceu esse crime terrível."

decisions.choice: Benjamin heard: the tribe knew of the gathering but did not come
decisions.reason: The verse sets Benjamin apart from the rest at the start. They heard of the assembly, yet they are not among those who came, and so the matter is heard without them.

decisions.choice: this evil: this wicked deed
decisions.reason: The word means evil or wickedness, here a crime. It is the word the tribes use again in verses 12 and 13, where they ask Benjamin to remove "the evil" from Israel.

decisions.choice: the sons of Benjamin (L); the Benjaminites (B); the men of Benjamin (R)
decisions.reason: In this chapter "sons of Benjamin" are the tribe's fighting men, so no gender setting is used. Balanced uses the tribe's name and Readable says "men"; Literal keeps the Hebrew form. The same holds for "the sons of Israel" from here to the end of the chapter: they are the gathered army of the other tribes (verses 2, 11, 17), so Balanced and Readable say "the Israelites" with no gender setting.

decisions.choice: the rest of
decisions.reason: Readable makes clear that "Israel" here means the other tribes, since Benjamin is part of Israel too.

decisions.choice: "les fils de Benjamin" (L); "les Benjaminites" (B); "les hommes de Benjamin" (R)
decisions.reason: As the English: Literal keeps the Hebrew "sons of", Balanced uses the name of the tribe's people, and Readable says "the men of Benjamin", since these are the tribe's fighting men. The sons of Israel in this chapter are the army and take no gender setting, as in the English.

decisions.choice: "베냐민 자손" at Literal; "베냐민 사람들" at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: As for "the sons of Ammon" and "the sons of Israel": Literal keeps the family word, the other levels name the people.

decisions.choice: "con cháu Bên-gia-min" (L), "người Bên-gia-min" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As with "con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên": Literal keeps "sons of", the other levels give the usual name of the tribe's people.

decisions.choice: os filhos de Benjamim (L); os benjamitas (B); os homens de Benjamim (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole chapter, as the English (r-en-1): the tribe's fighting men are "os filhos de Benjamim" at Literal, "os benjamitas" at Balanced, the form of 3:15 in Portuguese, and "os homens de Benjamim" at Readable; no gender setting.

source.text: וַיַּ֜עַן הָאִ֣ישׁ הַלֵּוִ֗י אִ֛ישׁ הָאִשָּׁ֥ה הַנִּרְצָחָ֖ה וַיֹּאמַ֑ר הַגִּבְעָ֨תָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְבִנְיָמִ֔ן בָּ֛אתִי אֲנִ֥י וּפִֽילַגְשִׁ֖י לָלֽוּן׃

records.literal_gloss: And answered the man the Levite, [the] husband of the woman the murdered, and said, [To] the Gibeah which [is] to Benjamin I came, I and my concubine, to spend the night.

en.L: And the Levite man, the husband of the woman who was murdered, answered and said, "I came to Gibeah, which belongs to Benjamin, I and my concubine, to spend the night.
en.B: The Levite, the husband of the murdered woman, answered, "My concubine and I came to Gibeah in Benjamin to spend the night.
en.R: The Levite whose wife had been murdered answered, "My concubine (a secondary wife) and I came to the town of Gibeah in Benjamin's land to stay for the night.

sw.L: Naye yule mtu Mlawi, mume wa yule mwanamke aliyeuawa, akajibu, akasema, "Mimi nilifika Gibea, ulio wa Benyamini, mimi na suria wangu, ili kulala.
sw.B: Yule Mlawi, mume wa yule mwanamke aliyeuawa, alijibu, "Mimi na suria wangu tulifika Gibea ya Benyamini ili kulala usiku.
sw.R: Yule Mlawi ambaye mkewe aliuawa alijibu, "Mimi na suria wangu (mke wa daraja la chini) tulifika katika mji wa Gibea katika nchi ya Benyamini ili kulala usiku.

es.L: Y respondió el hombre levita, el marido de la mujer asesinada, y dijo: «A Guibeá, que [es] de Benjamín, llegué yo con mi concubina para pasar la noche.
es.B: El levita, el marido de la mujer asesinada, respondió: «Mi concubina y yo llegamos a Guibeá de Benjamín para pasar la noche.
es.R: El levita cuya esposa había sido asesinada respondió: «Mi concubina (una esposa secundaria) y yo llegamos al pueblo de Guibeá, en la tierra de Benjamín, para pasar la noche.

fr.L: Et l’homme lévite, le mari de la femme qui avait été assassinée, répondit et dit : « C’est à Guibea, qui [appartient] à Benjamin, que je suis venu, moi et ma concubine, pour passer la nuit.
fr.B: Le Lévite, le mari de la femme assassinée, répondit : « Ma concubine et moi, nous étions venus passer la nuit à Guibea de Benjamin.
fr.R: Le Lévite dont la femme avait été assassinée a répondu : « Ma concubine (une épouse de second rang) et moi, nous étions venus dans la ville de Guibea, dans le pays de Benjamin, pour y passer la nuit.

vi.L: Người Lê-vi, chồng của người đàn bà bị giết, đáp lời và nói: "Tôi đến Ghi-bê-a thuộc về Bên-gia-min, tôi và vợ lẽ tôi, để nghỉ đêm.
vi.B: Người Lê-vi, chồng của người đàn bà bị giết, đáp: "Tôi và vợ lẽ tôi đến Ghi-bê-a thuộc Bên-gia-min để nghỉ đêm.
vi.R: Người Lê-vi có vợ bị giết trả lời: "Tôi và vợ lẽ tôi đến thành Ghi-bê-a trong đất Bên-gia-min để nghỉ đêm.

ko.L: 살해된 여자의 남편인 그 레위인이 대답하여 말했다. "저와 제 첩이 베냐민에 속한 기브아에 묵으러 갔습니다.
ko.B: 살해된 여자의 남편인 그 레위인이 대답했다. "저와 제 첩이 베냐민 땅 기브아에 하룻밤을 묵으러 갔습니다.
ko.R: 아내가 살해된 그 레위인이 대답했다. "저와 제 첩(두 번째 아내)이 베냐민 땅에 있는 기브아 성에서 하룻밤을 묵으려고 갔습니다.

pt.L: E o homem levita, o marido da mulher que tinha sido assassinada, respondeu e disse: "Eu vim a Gibeá, que [pertence] a Benjamim, eu e a minha concubina, para pernoitar.
pt.B: O levita, marido da mulher assassinada, respondeu: "Eu e a minha concubina chegamos a Gibeá de Benjamim para passar a noite.
pt.R: O levita cuja mulher tinha sido assassinada respondeu: "Eu e a minha concubina, uma esposa de posição inferior, chegamos à cidade de Gibeá, na terra de Benjamim, para passar a noite.

decisions.choice: the husband of the woman who was murdered: the narrator names the crime
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used for murder in the commandment (Exodus 20:13). The narrator calls her death murder before the Levite gives his account, and calls him her husband, though she was a concubine (19:1-3).

decisions.choice: concubine: a wife of lower standing
decisions.reason: A concubine was a lawful wife of lower rank than a full wife, often without a bride price or the same rights for her children. Chapter 19 calls the Levite her husband and her father his father-in-law (19:3-4).

decisions.choice: Gibeah, which belongs to Benjamin: the town of the crime
decisions.reason: The story is told in 19:12-28. Gibeah lay a few miles north of Jerusalem and was later the home of Saul, Israel's first king (1 Samuel 10:26).

decisions.choice: (a secondary wife)
decisions.reason: Readable explains "concubine" the first time it comes in the chapter.

decisions.choice: The Levite speaks to the assembly in the formal polite style (합쇼체)
decisions.reason: He addresses the whole gathered people, so he speaks up to them; the assembly answers and speaks among themselves in the plain style.

decisions.choice: assassinada
decisions.reason: The verb is the one for murder in the commandment (m1), and "assassinar" names the crime where "morta" would only say she died. Readable explains "concubina" the first time in the chapter, with the words of 19:1, as the English does.

source.text: וַיָּקֻ֤מוּ עָלַי֙ בַּעֲלֵ֣י הַגִּבְעָ֔ה וַיָּסֹ֧בּוּ עָלַ֛י אֶת־הַבַּ֖יִת לָ֑יְלָה אוֹתִי֙ דִּמּ֣וּ לַהֲרֹ֔ג וְאֶת־פִּילַגְשִׁ֥י עִנּ֖וּ וַתָּמֹֽת׃

records.literal_gloss: And rose against me [the] lords of the Gibeah, and surrounded against me the house [by] night; me they intended to kill, and my concubine they abused, and she died.

en.L: And the lords of Gibeah rose against me and surrounded the house around me at night. Me they intended to kill, and my concubine they abused, and she died.
en.B: The men of Gibeah rose against me and surrounded the house at night to get me. They meant to kill me. They raped my concubine, and she died.
en.R: During the night the leaders of Gibeah came after me and surrounded the house where I was. They wanted to kill me. Instead they raped my concubine, and she died.

sw.L: Nao wenyeji wa Gibea wakaniinukia, wakaizunguka nyumba juu yangu usiku. Mimi walikusudia kuniua, na suria wangu wakamnajisi, naye akafa.
sw.B: Watu wa Gibea waliniinukia, wakaizunguka nyumba usiku ili kunipata. Walikusudia kuniua. Walimbaka suria wangu, naye akafa.
sw.R: Usiku viongozi wa Gibea walinijia, wakaizunguka nyumba nilimokuwa. Walitaka kuniua. Badala yake walimbaka suria wangu, naye akafa.

es.L: Y se levantaron contra mí los señores de Guibeá, y rodearon de noche la casa contra mí. A mí pensaban matarme, y a mi concubina la violentaron, y murió.
es.B: Los hombres de Guibeá se levantaron contra mí y de noche rodearon la casa para atraparme. Querían matarme. Violaron a mi concubina, y murió.
es.R: Durante la noche los jefes de Guibeá vinieron por mí y rodearon la casa donde yo estaba. Querían matarme. En lugar de eso, violaron a mi concubina, y ella murió.

fr.L: Et les seigneurs de Guibea se levèrent contre moi et entourèrent la maison autour de moi, la nuit. Moi, ils pensaient me tuer, et ma concubine, ils l’ont violentée, et elle est morte.
fr.B: Les hommes de Guibea se sont levés contre moi et, la nuit, ils ont entouré la maison pour m’attraper. Ils voulaient me tuer. Ils ont violé ma concubine, et elle en est morte.
fr.R: Pendant la nuit, les chefs de Guibea m’ont poursuivi et ils ont entouré la maison où j’étais. Ils voulaient me tuer. À la place, ils ont violé ma concubine, et elle est morte.

vi.L: Các chủ nhân của Ghi-bê-a nổi lên chống tôi và ban đêm vây quanh nhà [để bắt] tôi. Chúng định giết tôi, còn vợ lẽ tôi thì chúng hãm hiếp, và nàng đã chết.
vi.B: Dân thành Ghi-bê-a nổi lên chống tôi, ban đêm vây quanh nhà để bắt tôi. Chúng định giết tôi. Chúng hãm hiếp vợ lẽ tôi, và nàng đã chết.
vi.R: Ban đêm, những người có thế lực ở Ghi-bê-a kéo đến bắt tôi và vây quanh căn nhà tôi đang ở. Chúng muốn giết tôi. Thay vào đó, chúng hãm hiếp vợ lẽ tôi, và nàng đã chết.

ko.L: 그런데 기브아의 주민들이 저를 치려고 일어나, 밤에 제가 있는 집을 에워쌌습니다. 그들은 저를 죽이려고 하였고, 제 첩을 욕보여서 그 여자가 죽었습니다.
ko.B: 그런데 기브아 사람들이 저를 치려고 일어나서, 밤에 제가 있던 집을 에워쌌습니다. 그들은 저를 죽이려고 했습니다. 그리고 제 첩을 성폭행하여 그 여자가 죽었습니다.
ko.R: 그런데 밤에 기브아의 우두머리들이 저를 잡으려고 와서, 제가 있던 집을 에워쌌습니다. 그들은 저를 죽이려고 했습니다. 그 대신 그들은 제 첩을 성폭행했고, 그 여자는 죽었습니다.

pt.L: E os senhores de Gibeá se levantaram contra mim e cercaram contra mim a casa, de noite. A mim pretendiam matar, e a minha concubina violentaram, e ela morreu.
pt.B: Os homens de Gibeá se levantaram contra mim e, de noite, cercaram a casa para me pegar. Eles queriam me matar. Estupraram a minha concubina, e ela morreu.
pt.R: Durante a noite, os líderes de Gibeá vieram atrás de mim e cercaram a casa onde eu estava. Eles queriam me matar. Em vez disso, estupraram a minha concubina, e ela morreu.

decisions.choice: the lords of Gibeah: its citizens, the men of standing in the town
decisions.reason: The word is the one used for a master or owner. Of a town it means its citizens, the free men who held its land and made its decisions (9:2). It puts the blame on the town's men, not only on a few.

decisions.choice: they intended to kill me: the Levite's own account of what they meant
decisions.reason: In 19:22 the men demanded to have sex with the man; the Levite now says they meant to kill him. He also leaves out that he himself put the woman out to them (19:25). The reader can compare his account with the story as it was told.

decisions.choice: abused: forced, raped
decisions.reason: The verb means to humble or afflict, and of a woman it means to force her (Genesis 34:2; 2 Samuel 13:14). Here it is the gang rape told in 19:25.

decisions.choice: the men of Gibeah (B); the leaders of Gibeah (R)
decisions.reason: "Lords" in English suggests nobles, so Balanced says "the men" and Readable "the leaders" (m1). Literal keeps "lords".

decisions.choice: os senhores de Gibeá (L), os homens (B), os líderes (R); violentaram (L), estupraram (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Senhores" at Literal for the town's citizens (m1), as 9:2 sets it in Portuguese for the men of Shechem. The verb of the crime (m3) keeps the words of 19:24-25: "violentar" at Literal, "estuprar" at Balanced and Readable, plainly and without more.

source.text: וָֽאֹחֵ֤ז בְּפִֽילַגְשִׁי֙ וָֽאֲנַתְּחֶ֔הָ וָֽאֲשַׁלְּחֶ֔הָ בְּכָל־שְׂדֵ֖ה נַחֲלַ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּ֥י עָשׂ֛וּ זִמָּ֥ה וּנְבָלָ֖ה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And I took hold of my concubine and I cut her in pieces and I sent her through all [the] field of [the] inheritance of Israel, for they have done lewdness and outrage in Israel.

en.L: And I took hold of my concubine and cut her in pieces and sent her through all the territory of the inheritance of Israel, for they have committed lewdness and an outrage in Israel.
en.B: So I took my concubine, cut her into pieces, and sent them throughout the whole land Israel had inherited, because they had done a shameful and outrageous thing in Israel.
en.R: So I took her body and cut it into pieces. I sent the pieces to every part of Israel's land, because these men had done a shameful and wicked thing in Israel.

sw.L: Nami nikamshika suria wangu, nikamkata vipande vipande, nikampeleka katika nchi yote ya urithi wa Israeli, kwa maana wametenda uasherati na upumbavu katika Israeli.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo nilimchukua suria wangu, nikamkata vipande vipande, nikavipeleka katika nchi yote ambayo Israeli waliirithi, kwa sababu walikuwa wametenda jambo la aibu na la kuchukiza katika Israeli.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo niliuchukua mwili wake, nikaukata vipande vipande. Nilivipeleka vipande hivyo katika kila sehemu ya nchi ya Israeli, kwa sababu watu hao walikuwa wametenda jambo la aibu na ovu katika Israeli.

es.L: Y tomé a mi concubina y la corté en pedazos, y la envié por todo el territorio de la heredad de Israel, porque han cometido una infamia y una vileza en Israel.
es.B: Así que tomé a mi concubina, la corté en pedazos y los envié por toda la tierra que Israel recibió en heredad, porque cometieron una infamia y una vileza en Israel.
es.R: Por eso tomé su cuerpo y lo corté en pedazos. Mandé los pedazos a todas las regiones de la tierra de Israel, porque esos hombres habían hecho algo vergonzoso y perverso en Israel.

fr.L: Et j’ai saisi ma concubine, et je l’ai coupée en morceaux, et je l’ai envoyée dans tout le territoire de l’héritage d’Israël, car ils ont commis une infamie et un outrage en Israël.
fr.B: Alors j’ai pris ma concubine, je l’ai coupée en morceaux et je les ai envoyés dans tout le pays qu’Israël a reçu en héritage, parce que ces gens ont commis une infamie et un crime odieux en Israël.
fr.R: Alors j’ai pris son corps et je l’ai coupé en morceaux. J’ai envoyé les morceaux dans toutes les régions du pays d’Israël, parce que ces hommes ont fait une chose honteuse et méchante en Israël.

vi.L: Tôi nắm lấy vợ lẽ tôi, chặt nàng ra từng phần và gửi nàng đi khắp đồng ruộng sản nghiệp của Y-sơ-ra-ên, vì chúng đã phạm điều dâm loạn và điều ô nhục trong Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Vậy tôi lấy xác vợ lẽ tôi, chặt ra từng phần và gửi đi khắp xứ mà Y-sơ-ra-ên đã nhận làm sản nghiệp, vì chúng đã làm một việc dâm loạn và ô nhục trong Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Vậy tôi lấy thi thể nàng và chặt ra từng phần. Tôi gửi các phần ấy đến khắp đất của Y-sơ-ra-ên, vì những người ấy đã làm một việc ô nhục và gian ác trong Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: 그래서 제가 제 첩을 붙잡아 토막을 내어 이스라엘의 유산인 온 땅에 보냈습니다. 그들이 이스라엘에서 음란하고 망령된 일을 저질렀기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 그래서 제가 제 첩을 데려다가 토막을 내어, 이스라엘이 유산으로 받은 온 땅에 보냈습니다. 그들이 이스라엘에서 음란하고 끔찍한 짓을 저질렀기 때문입니다.
ko.R: 그래서 저는 그 여자의 몸을 토막 내어 이스라엘 땅 곳곳에 보냈습니다. 그 사람들이 이스라엘에서 부끄럽고 악한 짓을 했기 때문입니다.

pt.L: E eu agarrei a minha concubina, e a cortei em pedaços, e a enviei por todo o território da herança de Israel, porque eles cometeram uma depravação e uma infâmia em Israel.
pt.B: Então peguei a minha concubina, cortei-a em pedaços e mandei os pedaços por toda a terra que Israel recebeu como herança, porque eles cometeram uma depravação e uma infâmia em Israel.
pt.R: Então peguei o corpo dela e o cortei em pedaços. Mandei os pedaços para todas as partes da terra de Israel, porque esses homens fizeram uma coisa vergonhosa e perversa em Israel.

decisions.choice: I cut her in pieces and sent her: the summons told in 19:29
decisions.reason: The same act is told in 19:29. Saul later sends pieces of oxen through Israel to call the tribes to war (1 Samuel 11:7). The pieces were a call that no tribe could ignore.

decisions.choice: lewdness and outrage: a shameful crime against what Israel must not do
decisions.reason: The first word is used for sexual wickedness that is planned (Leviticus 18:17). The second is used for acts that break the bonds of the people, such as the rape of Dinah (Genesis 34:7) and Amnon's rape of Tamar (2 Samuel 13:12). "In Israel" means such a thing is not to be done among God's people.

decisions.choice: the field of the inheritance of Israel: the whole land given to Israel
decisions.reason: "Field" here means territory, and "inheritance" is the land each tribe received as its share from God (Joshua 13-19).

decisions.choice: sent them (B); the pieces (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "sent her"; Balanced and Readable say what was sent, the pieces of her body.

decisions.choice: uma depravação e uma infâmia (L, B); uma coisa vergonhosa e perversa (R)
decisions.reason: The first word is planned sexual wickedness (m2), "depravação" in Portuguese; the second is the nevalah of 19:23-24, "infâmia" at Literal and Balanced and "coisa vergonhosa" at Readable, as set there. "Agarrei" at Literal keeps the verb of 19:25 and 29. In Balanced, "cortei-a" follows a comma inside a run of verbs; the clitic after the verb reads naturally there.

source.text: הִנֵּ֥ה כֻלְּכֶ֖ם בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הָב֥וּ לָכֶ֛ם דָּבָ֥ר וְעֵצָ֖ה הֲלֹֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Look, all of you [are] sons of Israel; give for yourselves word and counsel here.

en.L: Look, all of you [are] the sons of Israel; give for yourselves word and counsel here."
en.B: Now all of you, the Israelites, give your advice and decide what to do here."
en.R: All of you are the Israelites. So talk it over and decide right here what must be done."

sw.L: Tazama, ninyi nyote [ni] wana wa Israeli; jitoleeni hapa neno na shauri."
sw.B: Sasa ninyi nyote, Waisraeli, toeni shauri lenu na kuamua cha kufanya hapa."
sw.R: Ninyi nyote ni Waisraeli. Kwa hiyo lizungumzeni jambo hili na kuamua hapa hapa kinachopaswa kufanyika."

es.L: He aquí, todos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} [{{plural_you:son|sois}}] hijos de Israel; {{plural_you:den|dad}} aquí {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} palabra y consejo».
es.B: Ahora, todos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, israelitas, {{plural_you:den|dad}} {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} parecer y {{plural_you:decidan|decidid}} aquí qué hacer».
es.R: Todos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} {{plural_you:son|sois}} israelitas. Así que {{plural_you:hablen|hablad}} y {{plural_you:decidan|decidid}} aquí mismo lo que se debe hacer».

fr.L: Voici, vous [êtes] tous des fils d’Israël ; donnez-vous ici parole et conseil. »
fr.B: Maintenant, vous tous, Israélites, donnez votre avis et décidez ici ce qu’il faut faire. »
fr.R: Vous êtes tous des Israélites. Alors parlez-en ensemble et décidez ici même ce qu’il faut faire. »

vi.L: Này, tất cả các anh em [đều là] con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên; hãy đưa ra lời bàn và ý kiến tại đây."
vi.B: Bây giờ tất cả anh em, là dân Y-sơ-ra-ên, hãy góp ý và quyết định phải làm gì ngay tại đây."
vi.R: Tất cả anh em đều là dân Y-sơ-ra-ên. Vậy hãy bàn với nhau và quyết định ngay tại đây phải làm gì."

ko.L: 보십시오, 여러분은 모두 이스라엘 자손입니다. 여기에서 여러분의 의견과 계획을 내놓으십시오."
ko.B: 이제 여러분 이스라엘 자손은 모두 여기에서 의견을 내고 어떻게 할지 정하십시오."
ko.R: 여러분은 모두 이스라엘 백성입니다. 그러니 여기에서 함께 의논하고, 무엇을 해야 할지 정해 주십시오."

pt.L: Vejam, todos vocês [são] filhos de Israel; deem aqui a sua palavra e o seu conselho."
pt.B: Agora, todos vocês, israelitas, deem o seu parecer e decidam aqui o que fazer."
pt.R: Todos vocês são israelitas. Então conversem e decidam aqui mesmo o que deve ser feito."

decisions.choice: give word and counsel: decide together what to do
decisions.reason: To give a word and counsel is to speak and reach a decision. Chapter 19 ends with the same call: "consider it, take counsel, and speak" (19:30).

decisions.choice: all of you are sons of Israel: the appeal rests on their being one people
decisions.reason: The Levite appeals to them as Israel, the people the crime was done against (verse 6). Because they are all Israel, it is for all of them to decide.

decisions.choice: here
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable keep "here" to show that the decision is to be made at once, at the gathering.

decisions.choice: The Levite calls the assembly "anh em"
decisions.reason: A man speaking to his whole people: "anh em" includes everyone present and appeals to their being one family, which is the Levite's point (meaning decision).

source.text: וַיָּ֨קָם֙ כָּל־הָעָ֔ם כְּאִ֥ישׁ אֶחָ֖ד לֵאמֹ֑ר לֹ֤א נֵלֵךְ֙ אִ֣ישׁ לְאָהֳל֔וֹ וְלֹ֥א נָס֖וּר אִ֥ישׁ לְבֵיתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And arose all the people as one man, saying, Not we will go, a man to his tent, and not we will turn aside, a man to his house.

en.L: And all the people arose as one man, saying, "We will not go, any man to his tent, and we will not turn aside, any man to his house.
en.B: All the people rose up as one and said, "None of us will go home to his tent. Not one of us will return to his house.
en.R: All the people stood up together and said, "Not one of us will go back home.

sw.L: Nao watu wote wakainuka kama mtu mmoja, wakisema, "Hatutakwenda, hata mtu mmoja hemani kwake, wala hatutageuka, hata mtu mmoja nyumbani kwake.
sw.B: Watu wote waliinuka kama mtu mmoja, wakasema, "Hakuna hata mmoja wetu atakayekwenda nyumbani hemani kwake. Hakuna hata mmoja wetu atakayerudi nyumbani kwake.
sw.R: Watu wote walisimama pamoja, wakasema, "Hakuna hata mmoja wetu atakayerudi nyumbani.

es.L: Y se levantó todo el pueblo como un solo hombre, diciendo: «No iremos ninguno a su tienda, ni nos volveremos ninguno a su casa.
es.B: Todo el pueblo se levantó como un solo hombre y dijo: «Ninguno de nosotros volverá a su tienda. Ninguno regresará a su casa.
es.R: Todo el pueblo se puso de pie a la vez y dijo: «Ninguno de nosotros volverá a casa.

fr.L: Et tout le peuple se leva comme un seul homme, en disant : « Nous n’irons pas, chacun à sa tente, et nous ne nous retirerons pas, chacun à sa maison.
fr.B: Tout le peuple se leva comme un seul homme et dit : « Aucun de nous ne retournera à sa tente. Personne ne rentrera chez soi.
fr.R: Tout le peuple s’est levé d’un même élan et a dit : « Aucun de nous ne rentrera chez lui.

vi.L: Toàn dân đứng dậy như một người mà nói: "Không ai trong chúng ta sẽ về trại mình, và không ai sẽ trở về nhà mình.
vi.B: Toàn dân đứng dậy như một người và nói: "Không ai trong chúng ta sẽ về lều mình. Không một ai sẽ trở về nhà.
vi.R: Toàn dân cùng đứng dậy và nói: "Không một ai trong chúng ta sẽ về nhà.

ko.L: 온 백성이 한 사람처럼 일어나 말했다. "우리 가운데 아무도 자기 장막으로 가지 않겠고, 아무도 자기 집으로 돌아가지 않겠다.
ko.B: 온 백성이 한마음으로 일어나 말했다. "우리 가운데 아무도 자기 장막으로 돌아가지 않겠다. 아무도 자기 집으로 돌아가지 않겠다.
ko.R: 온 백성이 함께 일어나 말했다. "우리 가운데 한 사람도 집으로 돌아가지 않겠다.

pt.L: E todo o povo se levantou como um só homem, dizendo: "Não iremos, nenhum de nós, para a sua tenda, e não voltaremos, nenhum de nós, para a sua casa.
pt.B: Todo o povo se levantou como um só homem e disse: "Nenhum de nós irá para a sua tenda. Nenhum de nós voltará para a sua casa.
pt.R: Todo o povo se levantou como um só homem e disse: "Nenhum de nós vai voltar para casa.

decisions.choice: go to his tent, turn to his house: go home
decisions.reason: "To your tents" was the call to go home (1 Kings 12:16). Here both phrases say the same thing twice, a pledge that no man would go home until the matter was dealt with.

decisions.choice: as one man
decisions.reason: As in verse 1.

decisions.choice: Not one of us will go back home
decisions.reason: Readable joins the two matching lines into one, since both say the same thing (m1).

source.text: וְעַתָּ֕ה זֶ֣ה הַדָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר נַעֲשֶׂ֖ה לַגִּבְעָ֑ה עָלֶ֖יהָ בְּגוֹרָֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And now this [is] the thing which we will do to the Gibeah: against it by lot.

en.L: And now this [is] the thing that we will do to Gibeah: [we will go up] against it by lot.
en.B: This is what we will do to Gibeah: we will go up against it as the lot decides.
en.R: This is what we will do to Gibeah: we will cast lots to decide who goes up to attack it.

sw.L: Na sasa hili [ndilo] jambo tutakalowatendea Gibea: [tutapanda] juu yake kwa kura.
sw.B: Hili ndilo tutakalowatendea Gibea: tutapanda kuushambulia kama kura itakavyoamua.
sw.R: Hili ndilo tutakalowatendea Gibea: tutapiga kura kuamua ni nani atakayepanda kuushambulia.

es.L: Y ahora esto [es] lo que haremos a Guibeá: [subiremos] contra ella por sorteo.
es.B: Esto es lo que haremos con Guibeá: subiremos contra ella según lo decida la suerte.
es.R: Esto es lo que haremos con Guibeá: echaremos suertes para decidir quién sube a atacarla.

fr.L: Et maintenant, voici la chose que nous ferons à Guibea : [nous monterons] contre elle par le sort.
fr.B: Voici ce que nous ferons à Guibea : nous monterons contre elle selon ce que décidera le sort.
fr.R: Voici ce que nous allons faire à Guibea : nous allons tirer au sort ceux qui monteront l’attaquer.

vi.L: Bây giờ, đây là điều chúng ta sẽ làm cho Ghi-bê-a: [chúng ta sẽ đi lên] đánh thành theo thăm.
vi.B: Đây là điều chúng ta sẽ làm cho Ghi-bê-a: chúng ta sẽ đi lên đánh thành theo như thăm đã định.
vi.R: Đây là điều chúng ta sẽ làm cho Ghi-bê-a: chúng ta sẽ bắt thăm để xem ai sẽ đi lên tấn công thành.

ko.L: 이제 우리가 기브아에 할 일은 이것이다. 제비를 뽑아 그곳을 [치러 올라가겠다].
ko.B: 이제 우리가 기브아에 할 일은 이것이다. 제비를 뽑아 정해진 대로 그곳을 치러 올라가겠다.
ko.R: 우리는 기브아에 이렇게 하겠다. 제비를 뽑아 누가 올라가서 그곳을 칠지 정하겠다.

pt.L: E agora esta [é] a coisa que faremos a Gibeá: [subiremos] contra ela por sorte.
pt.B: É isto o que faremos a Gibeá: subiremos contra ela conforme a sorte decidir.
pt.R: É isto o que vamos fazer com Gibeá: vamos lançar sortes para decidir quem vai subir para atacá-la.

decisions.choice: against it by lot: a verb is understood, most likely "go up"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is brief and leaves out the verb. The Greek translation reads "we will go up against it by lot", which fits the next verse, where the lot picks the men who will gather supplies. It could also mean that the lot will decide which tribe attacks first, as God does in verse 18.

decisions.choice: by lot: letting God decide
decisions.reason: Casting lots was a way of leaving a choice to God (Proverbs 16:33; Joshua 7:14). The land itself had been shared out by lot (Joshua 18:10).

decisions.choice: [we will go up] / we will go up
decisions.reason: English needs the missing verb (m1). Literal brackets it.

decisions.choice: "제비" (lot)
decisions.reason: As the terms of this translation set for the lot.

decisions.choice: por sorte (L); conforme a sorte decidir (B); lançar sortes (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: casting lots leaves the choice to God (m2), and Portuguese says "lançar sortes", the phrase Joshua 18:10 uses in Portuguese for the lots at Shiloh; Literal keeps the bare "por sorte", as the Hebrew is brief.

source.text: וְלָקַ֣חְנוּ עֲשָׂרָה֩ אֲנָשִׁ֨ים לַמֵּאָ֜ה לְכֹ֣ל׀שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וּמֵאָ֤ה לָאֶ֨לֶף֙ וְאֶ֣לֶף לָרְבָבָ֔ה לָקַ֥חַת צֵדָ֖ה לָעָ֑ם לַעֲשׂ֗וֹת לְבוֹאָם֙ לְגֶ֣בַע בִּנְיָמִ֔ן כְּכָל־הַ֨נְּבָלָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And we will take ten men of [the] hundred, of all [the] tribes of Israel, and a hundred of [the] thousand, and a thousand of [the] ten thousand, to take provision for the people, to do, at their coming to Geba of Benjamin, according to all the outrage which it did in Israel.

en.L: And we will take ten men of [every] 100 from all the tribes of Israel, and 100 of [every] 1,000, and 1,000 of [every] 10,000, to take provisions for the people, to do, when they come to Geba of Benjamin, according to all the outrage that it did in Israel."
en.B: We will take ten men out of every 100 from all the tribes of Israel, 100 out of every 1,000, and 1,000 out of every 10,000, to bring food for the army. Then, when the army comes to Gibeah in Benjamin, it can repay them for all the outrage they committed in Israel."
en.R: We will choose one man in every ten from all the tribes of Israel to bring food for the army. Then the army can go to Gibeah in Benjamin and punish its people for the terrible thing they did in Israel."

sw.L: Nasi tutatwaa watu kumi kati ya [kila] 100 katika makabila yote ya Israeli, na 100 kati ya [kila] 1,000, na 1,000 kati ya [kila] 10,000, ili kuwaletea watu chakula, ili watende, watakapofika Geba ya Benyamini, sawasawa na upumbavu wote alioutenda katika Israeli."
sw.B: Tutachukua watu kumi kati ya kila 100 katika makabila yote ya Israeli, 100 kati ya kila 1,000, na 1,000 kati ya kila 10,000, ili walilee jeshi chakula. Kisha jeshi litakapofika Gibea ya Benyamini, litawalipa kwa upumbavu wote waliotenda katika Israeli."
sw.R: Tutachagua mtu mmoja kati ya kila watu kumi katika makabila yote ya Israeli ili walilee jeshi chakula. Kisha jeshi litaweza kwenda Gibea katika nchi ya Benyamini na kuwaadhibu watu wake kwa jambo baya walilolitenda katika Israeli."

es.L: Y tomaremos diez hombres de [cada] 100 de todas las tribus de Israel, y 100 de [cada] 1000, y 1000 de [cada] 10 000, para llevar provisiones al pueblo, para que hagan, cuando lleguen a Geba de Benjamín, conforme a toda la infamia que cometió en Israel».
es.B: De todas las tribus de Israel tomaremos diez hombres de cada 100, 100 de cada 1000 y 1000 de cada 10 000, para que lleven provisiones al ejército. Así, cuando el ejército llegue a Guibeá de Benjamín, podrá darles el pago que merece toda la infamia que cometieron en Israel».
es.R: De todas las tribus de Israel escogeremos a un hombre de cada diez para que lleve comida al ejército. Así el ejército podrá ir a Guibeá de Benjamín y castigar a su gente por la cosa terrible que hicieron en Israel».

fr.L: Et nous prendrons dix hommes sur [chaque] cent dans toutes les tribus d’Israël, et cent sur [chaque] 1 000, et 1 000 sur [chaque] 10 000, pour prendre des provisions pour le peuple, pour agir, à leur arrivée à Guéba de Benjamin, selon toute l’infamie qu’elle a commise en Israël. »
fr.B: Nous prendrons dans toutes les tribus d’Israël dix hommes sur cent, cent sur 1 000 et 1 000 sur 10 000, pour apporter des vivres à l’armée. Alors, quand l’armée arrivera à Guibea de Benjamin, elle pourra lui faire payer toute l’infamie qu’elle a commise en Israël. »
fr.R: Nous allons choisir un homme sur dix dans toutes les tribus d’Israël pour apporter de la nourriture à l’armée. Ensuite, l’armée pourra aller à Guibea de Benjamin et punir ses habitants pour la chose horrible qu’ils ont faite en Israël. »

vi.L: Chúng ta sẽ lấy mười người trong [mỗi] 100 từ mọi chi tộc Y-sơ-ra-ên, 100 trong [mỗi] 1.000, và 1.000 trong [mỗi] 10.000, để lo lương thực cho dân, để khi họ đến Ghê-ba thuộc Bên-gia-min, họ sẽ làm theo mọi điều ô nhục mà thành ấy đã làm trong Y-sơ-ra-ên."
vi.B: Chúng ta sẽ lấy mười người trong mỗi 100 người từ mọi chi tộc Y-sơ-ra-ên, 100 người trong mỗi 1.000, và 1.000 người trong mỗi 10.000, để lo lương thực cho quân đội. Rồi khi quân đội đến Ghi-bê-a thuộc Bên-gia-min, họ sẽ báo trả thành ấy về mọi điều ô nhục nó đã làm trong Y-sơ-ra-ên."
vi.R: Chúng ta sẽ chọn trong mọi chi tộc Y-sơ-ra-ên cứ mười người thì một người lo lương thực cho quân đội. Rồi quân đội có thể đi đến Ghi-bê-a thuộc Bên-gia-min mà trừng phạt dân ở đó về điều khủng khiếp họ đã làm trong Y-sơ-ra-ên."

ko.L: 이스라엘 모든 지파에서 백 명에 열 명, 천 명에 백 명, 만 명에 천 명을 뽑아, 백성을 위하여 양식을 가져오게 하겠다. 그리하여 그들이 베냐민 게바에 이르면, 그곳이 이스라엘에서 저지른 모든 망령된 일대로 갚게 하겠다."
ko.B: 우리는 이스라엘 모든 지파에서 백 명마다 열 명, 천 명마다 백 명, 만 명마다 천 명을 뽑아, 군대를 위해 양식을 나르게 하겠다. 그러면 군대가 베냐민의 기브아에 가서, 그들이 이스라엘에서 저지른 그 끔찍한 일을 모두 갚아 줄 수 있을 것이다."
ko.R: 우리는 이스라엘 모든 지파에서 열 사람에 한 사람씩 뽑아서 군대를 위해 양식을 나르게 하겠다. 그러면 군대가 베냐민의 기브아로 가서, 그들이 이스라엘에서 저지른 끔찍한 일에 대해 그곳 사람들을 벌할 수 있을 것이다."

pt.L: E tomaremos dez homens de [cada] cem, de todas as tribos de Israel, e cem de [cada] mil, e mil de [cada] dez mil, para levar provisões para o povo, para fazerem, quando chegarem a Geba de Benjamim, conforme toda a infâmia que ela cometeu em Israel."
pt.B: Vamos tomar dez homens de cada cem de todas as tribos de Israel, cem de cada mil e mil de cada dez mil, para trazer comida para o exército. Então, quando o exército chegar a Gibeá de Benjamim, poderá castigá-la por toda a infâmia que ela cometeu em Israel."
pt.R: Vamos escolher um homem em cada dez, de todas as tribos de Israel, para trazer comida para o exército. Então o exército poderá ir a Gibeá, em Benjamim, e castigar o seu povo pela coisa terrível que fez em Israel."

decisions.choice: one in ten to bring supplies: a tenth of the army to keep the rest fed
decisions.reason: An army in the field had to be fed. One man in ten would gather food so that the rest could stay and fight until the matter was finished.

decisions.choice: Geba of Benjamin: Gibeah
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has "Geba", a short form of the same name, which elsewhere names a different town nearby (verse 33). Here it must mean Gibeah, the town of the crime, as verses 4, 5 and 9 show.

decisions.choice: to do according to all the outrage: to punish them as the deed deserves
decisions.reason: "To do according to" the outrage means to deal with them as their crime requires. The town is the one that "did" the outrage (the verb is singular).

decisions.choice: Gibeah
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "Gibeah", so the reader does not take the name for another town (m2); Literal keeps "Geba".

decisions.choice: one man in every ten
decisions.reason: Readable gives the proportion once instead of listing it three times.

decisions.choice: "Geba ya Benyamini" at Literal, as the Hebrew spells it; "Gibea" at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: The Hebrew here has a shorter spelling of the name, but the town meant is Gibeah (m2); Literal keeps the spelling, the other levels use the name the reader has been following, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "Guéba de Benjamin" (L); "Guibea de Benjamin" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew here writes the short form of the town's name, Geba, for Gibeah (m2). Literal keeps the written form, "Guéba"; Balanced and Readable say which town is meant, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "Ghê-ba" at Literal, "Ghi-bê-a" at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: The Hebrew writes Geba here, a short form for Gibeah (meaning decision); Literal shows the spelling, the other levels the town meant, as the English does.

decisions.choice: Geba de Benjamim (L); Gibeá (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the name as the Hebrew writes it, "Geba", as Joshua 21:17 has the town in Portuguese; Balanced and Readable say "Gibeá", the town of the crime (m2), as the English does.

source.text: וַיֵּֽאָסֵ֞ף כָּל־אִ֤ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶל־הָעִ֔יר כְּאִ֥ישׁ אֶחָ֖ד חֲבֵרִֽים׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And gathered every man of Israel to the city, as one man, joined together.

en.L: And all the men of Israel gathered against the city, as one man, joined together.
en.B: So all the men of Israel gathered against the city, united as one.
en.R: So all the men of Israel came together to fight against the town. They were completely united.

sw.L: Nao watu wote wa Israeli wakakusanyika juu ya mji, kama mtu mmoja, wameungana.
sw.B: Basi watu wote wa Israeli walikusanyika kuushambulia mji, wameungana kama mtu mmoja.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo watu wote wa Israeli walikusanyika kupigana na mji huo. Walikuwa wameungana kabisa.

es.L: Y se reunieron todos los hombres de Israel contra la ciudad, como un solo hombre, unidos.
es.B: Así que todos los hombres de Israel se reunieron contra la ciudad, unidos como un solo hombre.
es.R: Así que todos los hombres de Israel se juntaron para pelear contra el pueblo. Estaban completamente unidos.

fr.L: Et tous les hommes d’Israël se rassemblèrent contre la ville, comme un seul homme, unis ensemble.
fr.B: Tous les hommes d’Israël se rassemblèrent donc contre la ville, unis comme un seul homme.
fr.R: Tous les hommes d’Israël se sont donc rassemblés pour attaquer la ville. Ils étaient tout à fait unis.

vi.L: Tất cả những người Y-sơ-ra-ên tụ tập chống lại thành, như một người, liên kết với nhau.
vi.B: Vậy tất cả những người Y-sơ-ra-ên tụ tập lại chống thành ấy, hiệp lại như một người.
vi.R: Vậy tất cả những người Y-sơ-ra-ên tụ họp lại để đánh thành ấy. Họ hoàn toàn hiệp một với nhau.

ko.L: 그래서 이스라엘의 모든 사람이 한 사람처럼 하나로 뭉쳐 그 성읍을 치려고 모였다.
ko.B: 그리하여 이스라엘의 모든 사람이 한마음으로 뭉쳐 그 성읍을 치려고 모였다.
ko.R: 그래서 이스라엘의 모든 남자가 그 성을 치려고 모였다. 그들은 완전히 하나가 되었다.

pt.L: E todos os homens de Israel se reuniram contra a cidade, como um só homem, unidos.
pt.B: Assim todos os homens de Israel se reuniram contra a cidade, unidos como um só homem.
pt.R: Então todos os homens de Israel se reuniram para lutar contra a cidade. Estavam unidos como um só homem.

decisions.choice: to the city: against Gibeah
decisions.reason: The preposition can mean "to" or "against". The city is Gibeah, and the tribes gathered to fight it.

decisions.choice: joined together: allies bound to one purpose
decisions.reason: The word means companions or allies. It is the third time the chapter says the tribes were "as one man" (verses 1 and 8).

decisions.choice: the men of Israel
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "every man of Israel", a collective for the whole army. English says "all the men".

source.text: וַֽיִּשְׁלְח֞וּ שִׁבְטֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֲנָשִׁ֔ים בְּכָל־שִׁבְטֵ֥י בִנְיָמִ֖ן לֵאמֹ֑ר מָ֚ה הָרָעָ֣ה הַזֹּ֔את אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִהְיְתָ֖ה בָּכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And sent [the] tribes of Israel men through all [the] tribes of Benjamin, saying, What [is] the evil the this which has happened among you?

en.L: And the tribes of Israel sent men through all the tribes of Benjamin, saying, "What [is] this evil that has happened among you?
en.B: The tribes of Israel sent men through the whole tribe of Benjamin to say, "What is this evil thing that has been done among you?
en.R: The tribes of Israel sent messengers to all the clans of Benjamin. They said, "What is this evil thing that has happened among you?

sw.L: Nao makabila ya Israeli wakatuma watu katika makabila yote ya Benyamini, wakisema, "Ni uovu gani huu uliotukia kwenu?
sw.B: Makabila ya Israeli walituma watu katika kabila lote la Benyamini kusema, "Ni uovu gani huu uliotendeka kati yenu?
sw.R: Makabila ya Israeli yalituma wajumbe kwa koo zote za Benyamini. Walisema, "Ni uovu gani huu uliotukia kati yenu?

es.L: Y las tribus de Israel enviaron hombres por todas las tribus de Benjamín, diciendo: «¿Qué [es] esta maldad que ha sucedido entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}?
es.B: Las tribus de Israel enviaron hombres por toda la tribu de Benjamín a decir: «¿Qué maldad es esta que se ha cometido entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}?
es.R: Las tribus de Israel enviaron mensajeros a todos los clanes de Benjamín. Les dijeron: «¿Qué maldad es esta que ha pasado entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}?

fr.L: Et les tribus d’Israël envoyèrent des hommes dans toutes les tribus de Benjamin, pour dire : « Qu’[est-ce que] ce mal qui est arrivé parmi vous ?
fr.B: Les tribus d’Israël envoyèrent des hommes dans toute la tribu de Benjamin pour dire : « Quel est ce crime qui a été commis chez vous ?
fr.R: Les tribus d’Israël ont envoyé des messagers à tous les clans de Benjamin. Ils ont dit : « Qu’est-ce que c’est que ce crime qui est arrivé chez vous ?

vi.L: Các chi tộc Y-sơ-ra-ên sai người đi khắp các chi tộc Bên-gia-min mà nói: "Điều ác đã xảy ra giữa các anh là gì vậy?
vi.B: Các chi tộc Y-sơ-ra-ên sai người đi khắp chi tộc Bên-gia-min để nói: "Điều ác đã xảy ra giữa các anh là gì vậy?
vi.R: Các chi tộc Y-sơ-ra-ên sai sứ giả đến với mọi gia tộc của Bên-gia-min. Họ nói: "Điều ác đã xảy ra giữa các anh là gì vậy?

ko.L: 이스라엘 지파들이 베냐민의 모든 지파에 사람들을 보내어 말했다. "너희 가운데에서 일어난 이 악한 일이 무엇이냐?
ko.B: 이스라엘 지파들은 베냐민 온 지파에 사람들을 보내어 말했다. "너희 가운데에서 저질러진 이 악한 일이 도대체 무엇이냐?
ko.R: 이스라엘 지파들은 베냐민의 모든 가문에 사자들을 보냈다. 그들이 말했다. "너희 가운데에서 일어난 이 악한 일이 무엇이냐?

pt.L: E as tribos de Israel enviaram homens por todas as tribos de Benjamim, dizendo: "Que mal [é] este que aconteceu entre vocês?
pt.B: As tribos de Israel enviaram homens por toda a tribo de Benjamim para dizer: "Que maldade é essa que foi cometida entre vocês?
pt.R: As tribos de Israel mandaram mensageiros a todos os clãs de Benjamim. Eles disseram: "Que maldade é essa que aconteceu entre vocês?

decisions.choice: the tribes of Benjamin: the clans of the one tribe
decisions.reason: Benjamin was one tribe, but the Hebrew says "tribes". The plural means its family groups or clans, as the same word does in Numbers 4:18.

decisions.choice: what is this evil: a question that is also a charge
decisions.reason: The question does not ask for facts the tribes already know (verses 4-7). It calls on Benjamin to own what has been done among them.

decisions.choice: the whole tribe of Benjamin (B); all the clans of Benjamin (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced uses the singular so the reader is not misled into thinking Benjamin was several tribes; Readable says "clans" (m1). Literal keeps "tribes".

source.text: וְעַתָּ֡ה תְּנוּ֩ אֶת־הָאֲנָשִׁ֨ים בְּנֵֽי־בְלִיַּ֜עַל אֲשֶׁ֤ר בַּגִּבְעָה֙ וּנְמִיתֵ֔ם וּנְבַעֲרָ֥ה רָעָ֖ה מִיִּשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְלֹ֤א אָבוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣יבִּנְיָמִ֔ן לִשְׁמֹ֕עַ בְּק֖וֹל אֲחֵיהֶ֥ם בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And now give the men, [the] sons of worthlessness who [are] in the Gibeah, and we will put them to death, and we will purge [the] evil from Israel. And not were willing [the] sons of Benjamin to listen to [the] voice of their brothers, [the] sons of Israel.

en.L: And now give [up] the men, the sons of worthlessness who [are] in Gibeah, that we may put them to death and purge the evil from Israel." But the sons of Benjamin were not willing to listen to the voice of their brothers, the sons of Israel.
en.B: Now hand over those worthless men in Gibeah, so that we can put them to death and remove this evil from Israel." But the Benjaminites would not listen to their brothers, the Israelites.
en.R: Now give us those wicked men in Gibeah. We will put them to death and so remove this evil from Israel." But the men of Benjamin refused to listen to their own relatives, the rest of the Israelites.

sw.L: Basi sasa watoeni wale watu, wana wa ubaya walioko Gibea, ili tuwaue na kuuondoa uovu katika Israeli." Lakini wana wa Benyamini hawakukubali kuisikiliza sauti ya ndugu zao, wana wa Israeli.
sw.B: Sasa watoeni wale watu wasiofaa kitu walioko Gibea, ili tuwaue na kuuondoa uovu huu katika Israeli." Lakini Wabenyamini hawakutaka kuwasikiliza ndugu zao, Waisraeli.
sw.R: Sasa tupeni wale watu waovu walioko Gibea. Tutawaua, na hivyo tutauondoa uovu huu katika Israeli." Lakini watu wa Benyamini walikataa kuwasikiliza ndugu zao, Waisraeli wengine.

es.L: Y ahora {{plural_you:entreguen|entregad}} a los hombres, los hijos de perversidad que [están] en Guibeá, para que los matemos y quitemos el mal de Israel». Pero los hijos de Benjamín no quisieron escuchar la voz de sus hermanos, los hijos de Israel.
es.B: Ahora {{plural_you:entreguen|entregad}} a esos hombres perversos de Guibeá, para que los matemos y quitemos este mal de Israel». Pero los benjamitas no quisieron escuchar a sus hermanos, los israelitas.
es.R: Ahora {{plural_you:entréguennos|entregadnos}} a esos hombres malvados de Guibeá. Los mataremos y así quitaremos este mal de Israel». Pero los hombres de Benjamín no quisieron escuchar a sus propios parientes, los demás israelitas.

fr.L: Et maintenant, livrez les hommes, les fils de vaurien qui [sont] à Guibea, afin que nous les fassions mourir et que nous ôtions le mal d’Israël. » Mais les fils de Benjamin ne voulurent pas écouter la voix de leurs frères, les fils d’Israël.
fr.B: Livrez-nous maintenant ces vauriens de Guibea, pour que nous les fassions mourir et que nous ôtions ce mal d’Israël. » Mais les Benjaminites ne voulurent pas écouter leurs frères israélites.
fr.R: Maintenant, donnez-nous ces hommes méchants de Guibea. Nous allons les faire mourir, et ainsi nous ôterons ce mal d’Israël. » Mais les hommes de Benjamin n’ont pas voulu écouter leurs propres frères, le reste des Israélites.

vi.L: Bây giờ hãy giao những người ấy, những kẻ đồi bại ở Ghi-bê-a, để chúng tôi xử tử chúng và trừ bỏ điều ác khỏi Y-sơ-ra-ên." Nhưng con cháu Bên-gia-min không chịu nghe tiếng anh em mình là con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Bây giờ hãy giao nộp những kẻ đồi bại ở Ghi-bê-a, để chúng tôi xử tử chúng và trừ bỏ điều ác này khỏi Y-sơ-ra-ên." Nhưng người Bên-gia-min không chịu nghe anh em mình là dân Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Bây giờ hãy giao cho chúng tôi những kẻ gian ác ở Ghi-bê-a. Chúng tôi sẽ xử tử chúng, để trừ bỏ điều ác này khỏi Y-sơ-ra-ên." Nhưng người Bên-gia-min không chịu nghe những người bà con của mình là các chi tộc khác của Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: 이제 기브아에 있는 그 사람들, 곧 그 불량한 자들을 [내어] 주어라. 우리가 그들을 죽여 이스라엘에서 악을 없애 버리겠다." 그러나 베냐민 자손은 그들의 형제 이스라엘 자손의 목소리를 들으려 하지 않았다.
ko.B: 이제 기브아에 있는 그 불량배들을 넘겨주어라. 우리가 그들을 죽여서 이스라엘에서 이 악을 없애 버리겠다." 그러나 베냐민 사람들은 그들의 형제인 이스라엘 자손의 말을 듣지 않았다.
ko.R: 이제 기브아에 있는 그 악한 자들을 우리에게 넘겨라. 우리가 그들을 죽여서 이스라엘에서 이 악을 없애겠다." 그러나 베냐민 사람들은 자기 친척인 다른 이스라엘 백성의 말을 듣지 않았다.

pt.L: E agora entreguem os homens, os filhos de perversidade que [estão] em Gibeá, para que os matemos e eliminemos o mal de Israel." Mas os filhos de Benjamim não quiseram ouvir a voz dos seus irmãos, os filhos de Israel.
pt.B: Agora entreguem esses homens perversos de Gibeá, para que os executemos e eliminemos esse mal de Israel." Mas os benjamitas não quiseram ouvir os seus irmãos israelitas.
pt.R: Agora entreguem esses homens maus de Gibeá a nós. Vamos executá-los e assim eliminar esse mal de Israel." Mas os homens de Benjamim não quiseram ouvir os seus próprios parentes, os outros israelitas.

decisions.choice: sons of worthlessness: wicked, lawless men
decisions.reason: "Sons of" a quality means men marked by it. The word means worthlessness or ruin, and it names men who break every bond of law and decency. It is the name the story gave the men of Gibeah in 19:22, and the one Deuteronomy uses for those who lead a town astray (Deuteronomy 13:14).

decisions.choice: purge the evil from Israel: the words of the law for a crime that must be punished
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy uses this phrase where a crime is so serious that the guilty must die so that the evil does not remain among the people (Deuteronomy 17:12; 22:21-22). The tribes ask first only for the guilty men, not for war.

decisions.choice: the sons of Benjamin: the reading for the margin
decisions.reason: The written Hebrew has only "Benjamin"; the traditional reading in the margin adds "the sons of". The meaning is the same either way: the tribe refused.

decisions.choice: would not listen to their brothers: Benjamin sides with the guilty men
decisions.reason: By refusing to give up the men, the tribe takes their side, and the matter becomes a war between brothers. The tribes call Benjamin "my brother" again in verses 23 and 28.

decisions.choice: worthless men (B); wicked men (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the meaning of the Hebrew expression (m1); Literal keeps "sons of worthlessness".

decisions.choice: filhos de perversidade (L), homens perversos (B), homens maus (R); eliminemos o mal de Israel
decisions.reason: The men are named as in 19:22 (m1), and "eliminar o mal" keeps the Portuguese of the law's phrase in Deuteronomy 22:21, "eliminarás o mal do meio de ti" (m2).

source.text: וַיֵּאָסְפ֧וּ בְנֵֽי־בִנְיָמִ֛ן מִן־הֶעָרִ֖ים הַגִּבְעָ֑תָה לָצֵ֥את לַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה עִם־בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And gathered [the] sons of Benjamin from the cities to the Gibeah, to go out to the battle with [the] sons of Israel.

en.L: And the sons of Benjamin gathered from the cities to Gibeah, to go out to battle against the sons of Israel.
en.B: Instead the Benjaminites came together from their towns to Gibeah, to go out and fight against the Israelites.
en.R: Instead the men of Benjamin left their towns and gathered at Gibeah to fight against the Israelites.

sw.L: Nao wana wa Benyamini wakakusanyika kutoka mijini mpaka Gibea, ili watoke kwenda vitani kupigana na wana wa Israeli.
sw.B: Badala yake Wabenyamini walikusanyika kutoka miji yao mpaka Gibea, ili watoke kwenda kupigana na Waisraeli.
sw.R: Badala yake watu wa Benyamini waliiacha miji yao, wakakusanyika Gibea ili kupigana na Waisraeli.

es.L: Y se reunieron los hijos de Benjamín de las ciudades en Guibeá, para salir a la batalla contra los hijos de Israel.
es.B: Al contrario, los benjamitas se juntaron en Guibeá desde sus ciudades para salir a pelear contra los israelitas.
es.R: Al contrario, los hombres de Benjamín dejaron sus pueblos y se reunieron en Guibeá para pelear contra los israelitas.

fr.L: Et les fils de Benjamin se rassemblèrent des villes à Guibea, pour sortir au combat contre les fils d’Israël.
fr.B: Au contraire, les Benjaminites quittèrent leurs villes et se rassemblèrent à Guibea pour sortir combattre les Israélites.
fr.R: Au contraire, les hommes de Benjamin ont quitté leurs villes et se sont rassemblés à Guibea pour combattre les Israélites.

vi.L: Con cháu Bên-gia-min tụ tập từ các thành về Ghi-bê-a để ra giao chiến với con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Thay vào đó, người Bên-gia-min từ các thành kéo về Ghi-bê-a, để ra đánh nhau với dân Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Thay vào đó, người Bên-gia-min rời các thành của mình và tập hợp tại Ghi-bê-a để đánh lại dân Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: 베냐민 자손은 이스라엘 자손과 싸우러 나가려고 여러 성읍에서 기브아로 모였다.
ko.B: 오히려 베냐민 사람들은 이스라엘 자손과 싸우러 나가려고 자기 성읍들에서 기브아로 모여들었다.
ko.R: 오히려 베냐민 사람들은 자기 성읍들을 떠나 기브아에 모였다. 이스라엘 백성과 싸우려는 것이었다.

pt.L: E os filhos de Benjamim se reuniram das cidades em Gibeá, para sair à batalha contra os filhos de Israel.
pt.B: Em vez disso, os benjamitas vieram das suas cidades e se reuniram em Gibeá para sair e lutar contra os israelitas.
pt.R: Em vez disso, os homens de Benjamim saíram das suas cidades e se reuniram em Gibeá para lutar contra os israelitas.

decisions.choice: they gathered from the cities to Gibeah: the whole tribe came to defend the guilty town
decisions.reason: Benjamin's answer is not to give up the guilty men but to bring its army to Gibeah. The verb is the same one used of Israel gathering in verse 11: two armies now gather against each other.

decisions.choice: to go out to battle (L); to go out and fight (B); to fight (R)
decisions.reason: "Going out to battle" is the chapter's phrase for marching out to fight (verses 20, 23, 28). Literal keeps it each time; Balanced and Readable say "fight".

source.text: וַיִּתְפָּֽקְדוּ֩ בְנֵ֨י בִנְיָמִ֜ן בַּיּ֤וֹם הַהוּא֙ מֵהֶ֣עָרִ֔ים עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וְשִׁשָּׁ֥ה אֶ֛לֶף אִ֖ישׁ שֹׁ֣לֵֽף חָ֑רֶב לְ֠בַד מִיֹּשְׁבֵ֤י הַגִּבְעָה֙ הִתְפָּ֣קְד֔וּ שְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת אִ֥ישׁ בָּחֽוּר׃

records.literal_gloss: And mustered themselves [the] sons of Benjamin on the day the that from the cities: twenty and six thousand man drawing [the] sword, apart from [the] inhabitants of the Gibeah, [who] mustered themselves: seven hundred man chosen.

en.L: And the sons of Benjamin mustered themselves on that day from the cities: 26,000 men drawing [the] sword, apart from the inhabitants of Gibeah, who mustered themselves, 700 chosen men.
en.B: That day the Benjaminites called up from their towns 26,000 men armed with swords, besides the people of Gibeah, who called up 700 chosen men.
en.R: That day Benjamin's towns counted 26,000 soldiers armed with swords. Gibeah itself added 700 of its best men.

sw.L: Nao wana wa Benyamini wakahesabiwa siku hiyo kutoka mijini: watu 26,000 wenye kufuta upanga, mbali na wenyeji wa Gibea, waliohesabiwa, watu 700 waliochaguliwa.
sw.B: Siku hiyo Wabenyamini waliita kutoka miji yao watu 26,000 wenye panga, mbali na wenyeji wa Gibea, walioita watu 700 waliochaguliwa.
sw.R: Siku hiyo miji ya Benyamini ilihesabu askari 26,000 wenye panga. Gibea yenyewe iliongeza watu wake bora 700.

es.L: Y se contaron los hijos de Benjamín aquel día, de las ciudades, 26 000 hombres que sacaban espada, aparte de los habitantes de Guibeá, que se contaron, 700 hombres escogidos.
es.B: Aquel día los benjamitas reclutaron en sus ciudades 26 000 hombres armados de espada, además de los habitantes de Guibeá, que reclutaron 700 hombres escogidos.
es.R: Aquel día las ciudades de Benjamín contaron 26 000 soldados armados con espadas. Guibeá misma añadió 700 de sus mejores hombres.

fr.L: Et les fils de Benjamin furent recensés en ce jour-là, [venant] des villes : 26 000 hommes tirant l’épée, sans compter les habitants de Guibea, qui furent recensés : 700 hommes d’élite.
fr.B: Ce jour-là, les Benjaminites recrutèrent dans leurs villes 26 000 hommes armés de l’épée, sans compter les habitants de Guibea, qui fournirent 700 hommes d’élite.
fr.R: Ce jour-là, les villes de Benjamin ont compté 26 000 soldats armés d’épées. Guibea a ajouté 700 de ses meilleurs hommes.

vi.L: Ngày ấy con cháu Bên-gia-min từ các thành điểm danh được 26.000 người cầm gươm, không kể dân cư Ghi-bê-a, là những người điểm danh được 700 người tinh nhuệ.
vi.B: Ngày ấy người Bên-gia-min từ các thành huy động được 26.000 người cầm gươm, không kể dân Ghi-bê-a huy động được 700 người tinh nhuệ.
vi.R: Ngày ấy các thành của Bên-gia-min đếm được 26.000 lính cầm gươm. Riêng thành Ghi-bê-a còn có thêm 700 người giỏi nhất.

ko.L: 그날 베냐민 자손이 여러 성읍에서 칼을 빼는 사람 이만 육천 명을 소집하였고, 그 밖에 기브아 주민들도 뽑힌 사람 칠백 명을 소집하였다.
ko.B: 그날 베냐민 사람들은 자기 성읍들에서 칼을 찬 사람 이만 육천 명을 불러 모았다. 그 밖에 기브아 주민들도 뽑힌 사람 칠백 명을 불러 모았다.
ko.R: 그날 베냐민의 성읍들에서 칼을 찬 군인 이만 육천 명이 모였다. 기브아에서도 가장 뛰어난 사람 칠백 명이 더 나왔다.

pt.L: E os filhos de Benjamim foram contados naquele dia, das cidades: vinte e seis mil homens que puxavam [a] espada, além dos habitantes de Gibeá, que foram contados: setecentos homens escolhidos.
pt.B: Naquele dia, os benjamitas convocaram das suas cidades vinte e seis mil homens armados de espada, além dos moradores de Gibeá, que convocaram setecentos homens escolhidos.
pt.R: Naquele dia, as cidades de Benjamim contaram vinte e seis mil soldados armados de espada. A própria Gibeá acrescentou setecentos dos seus melhores homens.

decisions.choice: mustered themselves: were counted for war
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used for counting men in a census (Numbers 1:3). Here it is a count of those who would fight.

decisions.choice: 26,000: the number in the Hebrew text
decisions.reason: Some copies of the Greek translation have a smaller number, 25,000 or 23,000. The Hebrew number fits the totals later in the chapter: 25,100 Benjaminites fall (verse 35) and 600 escape (verse 47), close to 26,000 plus the 700 men of Gibeah. On the size of such numbers see verse 2.

decisions.choice: chosen men: picked, trained fighters
decisions.reason: The word means men who were selected, the best fighters. Verse 16 describes them further.

decisions.choice: called up (B); counted (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable avoid the formal word "mustered"; Literal keeps it.

source.text: מִכֹּ֣ל׀הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֗ה שְׁבַ֤ע מֵאוֹת֙ אִ֣ישׁ בָּח֔וּר אִטֵּ֖ר יַד־יְמִינ֑וֹ כָּל־זֶ֗ה קֹלֵ֧עַ בָּאֶ֛בֶן אֶל־הַֽשַּׂעֲרָ֖ה וְלֹ֥א יַחֲטִֽא׃פ

records.literal_gloss: From all the people the this [were] seven hundred man chosen, restricted [in the] hand of his right; every this [one] slinging with the stone at the hair, and not missing.

en.L: Of all this people [there were] 700 chosen men restricted [in] their right hand; every one of these could sling with a stone at a hair and not miss.
en.B: Among all these soldiers were 700 picked men who fought left-handed, each able to sling a stone at a hair without missing.
en.R: Among these soldiers were 700 of the best fighters who were left-handed. Each of them could throw a stone with a sling and hit something as thin as a hair without missing.

sw.L: Katika watu hawa wote [walikuwako] watu 700 waliochaguliwa, waliofungwa mkono wao wa kuume; kila mmoja wa hawa angeweza kutupa jiwe kwa kombeo kwenye unywele, wala asikose.
sw.B: Kati ya askari hawa wote walikuwamo watu 700 waliochaguliwa waliopigana kwa mkono wa kushoto, kila mmoja akiweza kutupa jiwe kwa kombeo kwenye unywele bila kukosa.
sw.R: Kati ya askari hao walikuwamo wapiganaji bora 700 waliotumia mkono wa kushoto. Kila mmoja wao aliweza kutupa jiwe kwa kombeo na kupiga kitu chembamba kama unywele bila kukosa.

es.L: De todo este pueblo [había] 700 hombres escogidos, impedidos de su mano derecha; cada uno de estos tiraba con la honda una piedra a un cabello, y no fallaba.
es.B: Entre todos estos soldados había 700 hombres escogidos que eran zurdos, y cada uno podía lanzar con la honda una piedra a un cabello sin fallar.
es.R: Entre estos soldados había 700 de los mejores guerreros, que eran zurdos. Cada uno de ellos podía lanzar una piedra con la honda y dar en algo tan delgado como un cabello, sin fallar.

fr.L: De tout ce peuple, [il y avait] 700 hommes d’élite empêchés de la main droite ; chacun de ceux-là lançait à la fronde une pierre sur un cheveu et ne manquait pas.
fr.B: Parmi tous ces soldats, il y avait 700 hommes d’élite qui combattaient de la main gauche ; chacun d’eux pouvait lancer à la fronde une pierre sur un cheveu sans le manquer.
fr.R: Parmi ces soldats, il y avait 700 des meilleurs combattants, qui étaient gauchers. Chacun d’eux pouvait lancer une pierre avec une fronde et toucher une chose aussi fine qu’un cheveu, sans la manquer.

vi.L: Trong cả đoàn quân này [có] 700 người tinh nhuệ thuận tay trái; mỗi người đều có thể dùng ná ném đá trúng một sợi tóc mà không trật.
vi.B: Trong cả đoàn quân ấy có 700 người tinh nhuệ thuận tay trái, ai cũng có thể dùng ná bắn đá trúng một sợi tóc mà không trật.
vi.R: Trong số quân ấy có 700 người giỏi nhất thuận tay trái. Mỗi người đều có thể dùng ná bắn đá trúng một vật mảnh như sợi tóc mà không trật.

ko.L: 이 모든 백성 가운데 오른손이 묶인 뽑힌 사람 칠백 명이 있었는데, 그들은 모두 물매로 돌을 던져 머리카락도 빗나가지 않고 맞혔다.
ko.B: 이 모든 군인 가운데에는 왼손잡이인 정예 군사 칠백 명이 있었는데, 그들은 모두 물매로 돌을 던져 머리카락 한 올도 빗나가지 않고 맞힐 수 있었다.
ko.R: 이 군인들 가운데에는 왼손잡이인 가장 뛰어난 군사 칠백 명이 있었다. 그들은 모두 물매로 돌을 던져서, 머리카락처럼 가는 것도 빗나가지 않고 맞힐 수 있었다.

pt.L: De todo este povo, [havia] setecentos homens escolhidos, impedidos da mão direita; cada um destes atirava com a funda uma pedra num fio de cabelo e não errava.
pt.B: Entre todos esses soldados havia setecentos homens escolhidos, canhotos, e cada um deles era capaz de atirar uma pedra com a funda num fio de cabelo sem errar.
pt.R: Entre esses soldados havia setecentos dos melhores combatentes, que eram canhotos. Cada um deles conseguia atirar uma pedra com a funda e acertar uma coisa fina como um fio de cabelo, sem errar.

decisions.choice: restricted in his right hand: left-handed
decisions.reason: As at 3:15, where the same words describe Ehud of Benjamin. These men fought with the left hand, which made them harder to defend against. 1 Chronicles 12:2 tells of Benjaminites who could sling stones with either hand. The irony is the same as at 3:15: Benjamin means "son of the right hand".

decisions.choice: 700 chosen men: most likely the 700 of Gibeah from verse 15
decisions.reason: The same number and the same words, "700 chosen men", come in both verses, so the left-handed slingers are most likely Gibeah's 700. The verse could also describe a further group chosen from the whole Benjaminite army.

decisions.choice: slinging with a stone: a deadly weapon in skilled hands
decisions.reason: A sling was a pouch on two cords, swung to hurl a stone with great force. Slingers could strike from beyond the reach of swords, as David did (1 Samuel 17:49).

decisions.choice: not miss: the verb also means "sin"
decisions.reason: The verb means to miss a target or a goal. It is the usual word for sinning, falling short of what God requires, but here it has its plain sense.

decisions.choice: something as thin as a hair
decisions.reason: Readable says what hitting "a hair" means: a target so small it could hardly be seen.

decisions.choice: "waliofungwa mkono wao wa kuume" (bound in their right hand) at Literal; "waliopigana kwa mkono wa kushoto" (left-handed) at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture, as Judges 3:15 does for Ehud; the other levels say what it means (m1).

decisions.choice: "thuận tay trái" at Literal for "restricted in his right hand"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew picture means left-handed (meaning decision); a word-for-word "bị hạn chế tay phải" would mislead the Vietnamese reader into thinking of a disability.

decisions.choice: "오른손이 묶인" (restricted in the right hand) at Literal; "왼손잡이" at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew phrase, used also of Ehud in 3:15; the other levels give its sense.

decisions.choice: impedidos da mão direita (L); canhotos (B, R)
decisions.reason: The same words as Ehud's in 3:15 (m1), so each level keeps that verse's Portuguese: Literal "impedido da mão direita", Balanced and Readable "canhoto", the plain word for a left-handed man.

decisions.choice: atirava com a funda uma pedra (L, B, R); não errava
decisions.reason: "Funda" is the Portuguese word for the sling (m3), as in David's story; "errar" is to miss the mark, and Portuguese has no single word that also carries the sense "sin" (m4), so the note keeps it.

source.text: וְאִ֨ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל הִתְפָּֽקְד֗וּ לְבַד֙ מִבִּנְיָמִ֔ן אַרְבַּ֨ע מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֛לֶף אִ֖ישׁ שֹׁ֣לֵֽף חָ֑רֶב כָּל־זֶ֖ה אִ֥ישׁ מִלְחָמָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] men of Israel mustered themselves, apart from Benjamin: four hundred thousand man drawing [the] sword; every this [one was a] man of war.

en.L: And the men of Israel mustered themselves, apart from Benjamin, 400,000 men drawing [the] sword; every one of these [was] a man of war.
en.B: The men of Israel, not counting Benjamin, called up 400,000 men armed with swords, all of them experienced fighters.
en.R: Israel, not counting Benjamin, had 400,000 soldiers armed with swords. All of them were trained for war.

sw.L: Nao watu wa Israeli wakahesabiwa, mbali na Benyamini, watu 400,000 wenye kufuta upanga; kila mmoja wa hawa [alikuwa] mtu wa vita.
sw.B: Watu wa Israeli, bila kuhesabu Benyamini, waliita watu 400,000 wenye panga, wote wakiwa wapiganaji wenye uzoefu.
sw.R: Israeli, bila kuhesabu Benyamini, walikuwa na askari 400,000 wenye panga. Wote walikuwa wamefundishwa vita.
